newsitem.title: UK: UK's Independent Insurance in USF&G pact.
newsitem.headline: UK's Independent Insurance in USF&G pact.

text.p: Independent Insurance Group Plc said on Wednesday it signed a cooperation agreement with USF&G Corp's United States Fidelity & Guaranty Co unit.
Under the deal, USF&G and Independent Insurance will offer underwriting services and insurance cover to each other's clients for incidental risks based in their own territories.
Independent said the deal would extend both companies' client base.

"It provides us with a new income stream, allows us to increase our cover to existing clients and to compete with the larger insurance companies for UK clients with U.S. incidental risks," the company said in a statement.
